iece:** the residual still depends on time in a way I could not pin down. Adding t·cos(ωt) or a decaying exp(−t) term helped only partially.

The best scored candidate was the 10-parameter model dv = p0 + p1·x + p2·v + p3·x³ + (p4 + p5·v + p6·t)·cos(p7·t) + (p8 + p9·v)·sin(p7·t), with NMSE 1.618e-3.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    w=p[7]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    return p[0]+p[1]*x+p[2]*v+p[3]*x**3+(p[4]+p[5]*v+p[6]*t)*c+(p[8]+p[9]*v)*s
